status: Concept references used for exo-creature-models.mjs and exo-guardian.mjs; images are documentation, not runtime models.

roster.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production concept-art sheet for an existing 3D sci-fi mecha exploration game.
Primary request: redesign four alien enemies with convincing anatomy, strong silhouettes, and physically understandable attacks, replacing crude geometric monsters.
Scene/backdrop: restrained pale warm-gray studio background, clean professional art-direction board, no scenery obscuring anatomy.
Subject: four clearly separated full-body creatures, each shown in a large readable three-quarter view, with a small side silhouette and two small action keyposes beneath its own design. All creatures share an evolved obsidian chitin / weathered mineral armor ecosystem, exposed flexible tendon regions, layered plates, grounded believable joints. Use restrained luminous attack organs, not random glowing decorations.
1 HUNTER: lean six-limbed predatory insect, low head with split mandibles, long spring-loaded hind legs, agile narrow waist, cyan sensory eyes; crouch anticipation then extended forward pounce.
2 CHARGER: broad four-legged armored siege beast, wedge-shaped horned head, heavy forequarters and muscular rear legs, overlapping scuffed mineral plates, amber warning organs; lowered braced windup then forceful straight charge.
3 SPORE ARTILLERY: six-legged crab-spider, stable broad stance, translucent olive bioluminescent pressure sacs and a distinct anatomical dorsal mortar organ; anchored leg brace then sac contraction and a clear arcing spore launch.
4 BROOD LORD: towering alien arthropod with two massive articulated forearms, four supporting legs, crown-like armor ridge and red-orange thoracic organ; torso coil then sweeping arm strike with shockwave impact. Menacing and original, no recognizable franchise creatures.
Style/medium: premium realistic game concept painting, detailed functional material definition, sculptable volumes, high-end creature design, readable even in thumbnail, no generic polygon geometry. Orthographic side thumbnails must match the main design.
Composition/framing: wide landscape sheet, four equally spaced vertical columns; all appendages visible and uncropped, generous negative space, crisp neutral lighting with subtle warm rim. A tiny white humanoid mecha silhouette near each design communicates relative scale; hunter shorter than mecha, charger similar height, artillery slightly taller, brood lord three times taller.
Text: only the short labels "HUNTER", "CHARGER", "SPORE ARTILLERY", "BROOD LORD". No paragraphs or fake technical labels. No watermark.
Constraints: concept art for subsequent Blender modeling and animation, not a gameplay screenshot. Show clean contact points and distinct windup versus attack body mechanics. No gore.

guardian.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: creature modeling and attack-direction concept board for a sci-fi mecha game.
Primary request: design the VOID LEVIATHAN, a terrifying colossal boundary guardian that eliminates mechs crossing the forbidden outer region. Replace a crude monster with a memorable, original and anatomically coherent creature.
Subject: a vast abyssal alien that emerges from a storm of volcanic ash. Long heavily armored segmented body, six enormous jointed anchoring limbs with distinct elbows and mineral claws, a low skull-like cranial shield with several recessed amber eyes, interlocking mandibles around a restrained white-hot energy throat. Weathered basalt black carapace, eroded bone-gray armor edges, dark flexible membranes and muscle under the plates, faint hot orange fissures. An original alien animal, not a dragon, not a mechanical robot, not a copied film or game creature. All six limbs must have clear attachment points and plausible joint mechanics. Scale is hundreds of meters; a tiny white humanoid combat mech looks insect-sized at its feet.
Composition: cinematic wide landscape professional concept sheet. Left two-thirds: one striking full-body three-quarter hero view in a cold ash basin, distant storm clouds, sparse ground fires, dusty scale cues, ominous realistic lighting while keeping anatomy readable. Right third on a neutral gray field: clean side silhouette of the same creature at top, and three small sequential poses below showing (1) alert head turn and planted limbs, (2) body lowering and throat charging, (3) focused energy discharge toward a tiny silhouette outside a boundary marker. Clear visual windup and planted support, no floppy limbs.
Style: premium realistic game creature design / film production concept art, extraordinary silhouette and material detail, restrained color palette, crisp sculptable forms, professional composition, not a collage of unrelated creatures.
Text: title "VOID LEVIATHAN"; short three-pose labels "DETECT", "CHARGE", "STRIKE". No other text or watermark.
Constraints: concept art, not a claim of existing in-game graphics; no gore, no dismemberment, no recognizable franchise design.
